changes.comment: Rich text in a repeater row is stored in a file named by the row's key, such as `sections.k3f9a2.body.mdoc`, not by its number, so a new order of the rows changes only `index.json`. Rows with rich text have a `_key` in the JSON. Content from earlier versions is converted once with `npx mica migrate-layout`; until then, Mica refuses to read it.
